content.json:
Dell Command Update Information

Dell Command Update information gathered from WMI

Here you can view Dell devices and see what Dell Command Updates have run and their status
List of all computers with service tag

content.query:
DellDCUWMI_CL
| project 
    ComputerName = ComputerName_s,
    ServiceTag = ServiceTag_s
| distinct *
| order by ComputerName

content.json:
You can search for a pc name or choose from a drop down.

Clear the PC Name field when using the drop down.

parameters.name: PCDropdown
parameters.query:
DellDCUWMI_CL
| summarize by ComputerName_s
| project value = ComputerName_s, label = ComputerName_s
| order by value asc

content.query:
DellDCUWMI_CL
| where ComputerName_s =~ iff(
    isnotempty("{PCName}"),
    "{PCName}",
    "{PCDropdown}"
  )
| project 
    ComputerName = ComputerName_s,
    ServiceTag = ServiceTag_s,
    UpdateID = UpdateID_s,
    Component = Component_s,
    EventStatus = EventStatus_s,
    ReturnCode = ReturnCode_s,
    RebootRequired = iff(RebootRequired_d == 1, "Yes", "No"),
    Display = Display_s,
    VendorVersion = VendorVersion_s
| distinct *
| order by Component

content.json: Search for return codes

parameters.name: ReturnCode
parameters.label: Return Code
parameters.query:
DellDCUWMI_CL
| where isnotempty(ReturnCode_s)
| project ReturnCode = ReturnCode_s
| distinct ReturnCode
| order by ReturnCode asc

content.query:
DellDCUWMI_CL
| where ReturnCode_s == "{ReturnCode}"   // or =~ or contains
| project 
    ComputerName = ComputerName_s,
    ServiceTag = ServiceTag_s,
    UpdateID = UpdateID_s,
    Component = Component_s,
    EventStatus = EventStatus_s,
    ReturnCode = ReturnCode_s,
    RebootRequired = iff(RebootRequired_d == 1, "Yes", "No"),
    Display = Display_s,
    VendorVersion = VendorVersion_s
| distinct *
| order by ComputerName, Component

content.json: Search by Update ID. This is the 5 digit code Dell uses for each unique update.

parameters.name: IDDropdown
parameters.label: UpdateID Dropdown
parameters.query:
DellDCUWMI_CL
| where isnotempty(UpdateID_s)
| summarize by UpdateID_s
| order by UpdateID_s asc
| project value = tostring(UpdateID_s), label = tostring(UpdateID_s)

content.query:
let filterID = iff("{UpdateID}" != "", "{UpdateID}", "{IDDropdown}");
DellDCUWMI_CL
| where filterID == "" or UpdateID_s == filterID
| project 
    TimeGenerated,
    ComputerName_s,
    ServiceTag_s,
    UpdateID_s,
    Component_s,
    EventStatus_s,
    ReturnCode_s,
    Successful_d,
    RebootRequired_d,
    Display_s,
    VendorVersion_s
| order by ComputerName_s asc, TimeGenerated desc

content.json: Search for Display name. This is the actual driver or package name that was installed

parameters.name: Display
parameters.label: DisplayName
parameters.query:
DellDCUWMI_CL
| where isnotempty(Display_s)
| distinct Display_s
| order by Display_s asc

content.query:
DellDCUWMI_CL
| where isempty("{Display}") or Display_s =~ "{Display}"
| project 
    ComputerName = ComputerName_s,
    ServiceTag = ServiceTag_s,
    UpdateID = UpdateID_s,
    Component = Component_s,
    EventStatus = EventStatus_s,
    ReturnCode = ReturnCode_s,
    RebootRequired = iff(RebootRequired_d == 1, "Yes", "No"),
    Display = Display_s,
    VendorVersion = VendorVersion_s
| distinct *
| order by ComputerName, Component
